name: eSui Dollar
oneLiner: suiUSDe is Sui's Ethena-whitelabel synthetic dollar; peg depends on Ethena-style delta-neutral basis-trade backing and the Sui deployment's admin controls.
collateral: Ethena whitelabel synthetic-dollar backing using digital-asset collateral and short futures exposure for the Sui deployment
pegMechanism: Sui-native Ethena whitelabel dollar asset whose peg quality depends on Ethena-style delta-neutral backing and Sui deployment controls

oracleRisk.summary: Sui describes suiUSDe as an Ethena-powered synthetic dollar backed by digital assets and corresponding short futures positions, but the reviewed public material does not disclose a suiUSDe-specific oracle implementation or failover path.

branchApplicability.rationale: Official Sui material describes suiUSDe as an issuer-managed Ethena Whitelabel synthetic dollar backed by a portfolio of digital assets and short futures, not as a permissionless borrowing market where users open collateralized debt positions subject to per-collateral onchain liquidation branches.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: suiUSDe minting is controlled via a Treasury shared object that wraps the TreasuryCap. The single AdminRole holder (0xe3dbc438…) also holds the package UpgradeCap, giving one EOA full mint and upgrade authority.

upgradeability.controlRef: suiUSDe AdminRole holder (mints via Treasury) and UpgradeCap owner

sources.label: Sui fullnode RPC — suiUSDe package UpgradeCap

controls.label: suiUSDe Treasury shared object (wraps TreasuryCap)
controls.capDescription: TreasuryCap<SUI_USDE> is wrapped inside the shared Treasury object, so minting must route through Treasury module logic rather than an externally held TreasuryCap.
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 285785957, sui_getObject for 0xe6c3c84c…40366ea returns type treasury::Treasury, owner Shared (initial_shared_version 758887726). Dynamic object field read confirms TreasuryCap<SUI_USDE> (id 0xae5039…54bda) is wrapped inside the Treasury (ObjectOwner pointing to the Treasury's inner dynamic-field wrapper at 0x19a91d…0c21). DenyCap and MetadataCap are also stored inside the Treasury object (deny_cap and metadata_cap fields confirmed).

controls.label: suiUSDe AdminRole holder (mints via Treasury) and UpgradeCap owner
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 285785957: suix_queryEvents for RoleAuthorized<AdminRole> returns a single event (tx 97LB9KNbTjNFwq2QXdA6HzSe4RjSXa63Y2WFP6fBaBfx) granting AdminRole to 0xe3dbc438…. Additional events confirm this address also holds EpochPeriodManagerRole, GlobalDisablerRole, CollateralManagerRole, CollateralDisablerRole, BenefactorManagerRole, BenefactorDisablerRole, PegManagerRole, OracleManagerRole, and DenylistManagerRole. suix_getOwnedObjects confirms UpgradeCap 0x764653924d7bc3b8… (policy=0 COMPATIBLE, version=2, current package 0x341079b4…) is also owned by this address; re-read at checkpoint 298482440. sui_getObject for the address returns notExists confirming it is an EOA (Sui address, not a smart contract).

review.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 285785957: TreasuryCap<SUI_USDE> (id 0xae5039…) is wrapped inside Treasury shared object 0xe6c3c84c… as a dynamic object field. AdminRole and all operational roles are held by EOA 0xe3dbc438…, which also owns the package UpgradeCap (policy=0). The deployer 0xcebe2945… initially held roles but they were rotated to 0xe3dbc438… before the current state. DenyCap is stored inside the Treasury (not externally owned). All mint-capable surfaces confirmed.
